title: Business Ethics
description: A professional and inclusive scene depicting business ethics, featuring a diverse group of people of various colors and races, including individuals of African origin. In the foreground, business professionals and ethicists are engaged in a serious discussion around a conference table, surrounded by laptops, documents, and ethical guidelines. The setting includes elements like a whiteboard with ethical principles, financial charts, and a balance scale. The background features a modern office environment with glass walls, a cityscape view, and symbols of corporate social responsibility, such as recycling bins and community engagement posters. The atmosphere is focused and collaborative, capturing the essence of ethical considerations in the business world.
